summary_1line: Drona tests his pupils’ focus; only Arjuna succeeds, later saving Drona from a crocodile and receiving the devastating Brahmasira weapon.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands with bow drawn beneath a tree, calmly aiming while a wooden bird sits on a high branch and Drona watches intently.
Arjuna’s arrow slices through the air and knocks the head off the bird perched atop the tree while the watching students stand astonished.
In the Ganga’s water a crocodile grips Drona’s thigh while Arjuna on the bank fires arrows into the river to rescue his teacher.
